summary: Iteration 8: independently verified heritage lookup API (incl. 404/422/auth paths), Heritage Impact Statement + 01.1 TOC sub-row in pack.html, per-measure 'Existing Condition · Survey' photo strips, embedded defect photos in Section 08, pack.pdf regression, and the new drag-and-drop upload UI on /import. 13/13 new backend tests pass, 11/11 iteration-7 regression tests (auth playbook + defect CRUD) pass. Frontend drag-and-drop verified for all 4 measure slots + datasheets (multi-file), plus dragover hint, clear buttons, click-to-browse input and Generate button enable/disable. No functional defects found; 3 non-blocking observations reported (heritage never auto-populated / no UI trigger, 4.35MB pack.html load latency, misleading heritage summary when the external API fails).

minor.issue: When postcodes.io/planning.data.gov.uk is unreachable the response contains error='Lookup service unavailable' but _heritage_statement() still stamps designated=false with the summary 'No statutory heritage designations ... were identified'. The pack then prints a positive 'no designations' statement even though no lookup actually happened. Suggest: when h.get('error') is set, emit a 'Heritage lookup could not be completed - confirm with the LPA' summary instead.

Response is now 4.35 MB (32 embedded data:image URIs). Cold response took 20.6s (warm 7.1s) and one browser navigation to pack.html exceeded a 30s timeout in Playwright. Consider downscaling/JPEG-recompressing embedded survey photos before base64 embedding.

CORS_ORIGINS="*" in backend/.env combined with allow_credentials=True. Starlette echoes the origin so cookie auth works, but the playbook asks for explicit origins - recommend setting the preview/prod origins explicitly.

integration_issues.issue: There is no frontend trigger for the heritage lookup (grep for 'heritage' in /app/frontend/src returns nothing), and neither the seed nor the AI import pipeline calls _heritage_lookup_sync. project.heritage exists on RTF-2026-0140 only because the lookup was curl'ed manually; after POST /api/reseed the Heritage Impact Statement page (and the 01.1 TOC row) will silently vanish from every pack. Add a 'Run heritage lookup' action in the project UI and/or call the lookup during seed/import.

action_items: Auto-populate project.heritage (seed + AI import) and/or expose a heritage-lookup button in the project UI so the Heritage Impact Statement survives a reseed and is reachable without curl
Handle heritage lookup failure explicitly instead of asserting 'no designations found'
Reduce embedded photo payload in pack.html (4.35 MB / up to 20s cold load)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2431 lines - build_pack_html and the heritage helpers should be split into modules (pack_builder.py, heritage.py) per the 700-line guideline
_heritage_lookup_sync swallows all exceptions into a generic dict; postcodes.io 404 vs network failure are indistinguishable to the caller apart from the message string

success_rate.frontend: 100% (drag-and-drop, clear, browse, counter, generate enable/disable all pass)

seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo project TEST-NOPC-<random> created and deleted inside test_lookup_422_without_postcode. Project list back to the 8 seeded projects; RTF-2026-0140 retains postcode S10 2SE, 2 defects with photos and the heritage document.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suites: tests/test_iter7_auth.py, tests/test_iter7_defects.py, tests/test_iter8_heritage_pack.py (run with plain `pytest tests/<file> -v`; pytest.ini injects xdist loadscope, do not pass -p no:xdist). pack.html for RTF-2026-0140 = 44 pages, 32 data:image URIs, 3 'Existing Condition · Survey' strips, Section 08 is page 43 with 2 embedded defect photos. When asserting on defect photos, split pack.html on `class="page"` and match the page containing 'Section 08' - a naive find() on 'Defects & Remedial Actions' hits the Contents row and gives a false positive. Playwright: pack.html navigation may exceed the default 30s timeout; log in via data-testid login-email/login-password/login-submit then goto /api/projects/{id}/pack.html. Drag-and-drop is simulated with evaluate_handle DataTransfer + dispatch_event('drop', {dataTransfer: dt}); the ready chip renders uppercase 'READY'.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defect reproduced this iteration. The heritage-page fragility RCA: build_pack_html only emits heritage_page when p.get('heritage') is truthy, and the only writer of that field is POST /api/projects/{id}/heritage/lookup, which nothing (seed, import, frontend) calls - so the feature is invisible unless the endpoint is hit manually.
